**GAIA**

*GAIA* is a POS (Point-of-Sale) system integrated with an algorithm to identify and evaluate system latency and desynchronization. The system is web-based and will be implemented in a webhost service. The system is built with both the Julia programming language for the analytics logic and C# with the ASP.NET and MVC for for the actual website. The POS system will have the following features:

- [x] Client-friendly dashboard for easy integration from common POS systems
- [x] Latency identifier on Admin Dashboard to evaluate system degredation
